messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered at 1753201234 for gateway-prod-eu — sustained 5xx spike (~12%) and higher timeouts observed. Paging current oncall.
Sasha: ack — jumping in. Opening traces and logs now.
Manu: infra looking. Any deploys recently? @Deploy-bot status?
Deploy-bot: no deploys in the last 60m.
Sasha: symptoms: burst of 429s followed by proxy 502/504 cascades. Suspect quota enforcement interaction + retry amplification.
Priya: I'm the oncall — taking lead. Roles: Priya (incident lead), Sasha (SRE), Manu (infra), Carl (support), Emma (product).
Priya: immediate ask: Carl, pull top affected tenants and surface any enterprise-impact tickets.
Carl: running support query for last 30m, will list top-affected accounts.
InfraBot: rate-shaper metrics show tenant_bucket_overflow +420% for tenant acme-markets-eu. Global token-bucket util at 98% on gateway-prod-eu.
Sasha: running quick grep across gateway logs to correlate 429->502 chain:
```
# sample search
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/gateway-prod-eu --since=15m | jq -r '. | select(.status==429 or .status==502) | [.ts, .tenant, .status] | @csv' | head -n 200
```
Sasha: found block: many 429s for acme-markets-eu starting 1753201100, then surge of 502/504s ~1753201220. Looks like rate enforcement triggered retries -> upstream saturation.
Manu: I see a config change to rate-shaper at 1753199900 that adjusted policy selectors. It appears the selector matched more tenants than intended, effectively applying tight per-tenant buckets to high-throughput tenants.
Priya: mitigation options (ranked by speed): 1) rollback recent rate-shaper change, 2) widen buckets for affected tenants, 3) enable soft-fail mode so rate-shaper returns throttled responses instead of hard 429s. What's fastest to reduce retry storm?
Manu: soft-fail toggle is fastest. It will cause the rate-shaper to degrade to soft throttling and avoid generating high-volume 429s that provoke retries. I can flip the env flag in ~30s.
Sasha: parallel: I'll stage an edge bypass for the most impacted tenant so traffic goes direct to warmed nodes and bump gateway connection timeout to cut down on 504s.
Priya: do both. Manu, Sasha — execute and report back.
Manu: applying soft-fail now:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/rate-shaper SOFT_FAIL=true --record
```
Manu: patched. Observability shows 429 emission rate dropping.
Sasha: applying temporary bypass for acme-markets-eu and increasing connection timeout to 90s:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://proxy-api.internal/proxy/bypass -d '{"tenant":"acme-markets-eu","duration":"15m"}'
# then
kubectl -n prod patch deployment gateway-prod-eu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"CONN_TIMEOUT","value":"90s"}]}]}}}}'
```
Sasha: bypass in place. Edge timeout increased.
InfraBot: metrics update: 429 rate for acme-markets-eu dropped toward baseline within 60s. 5xx rate decreased from ~12% to ~4% in the following 3m.
Carl: support update: pulled top-10 impacted tenants; three enterprise customers are affected. CS reaching out with workaround and ETA ~30m. Preparing acknowledgement messages.
Priya: assign follow-ups: Manu -> prepare rollback PR to revert mis-scoped selector; Sasha -> edge timeout/ dedupe rule patch; Emma -> own postmortem and customer comms; Carl -> finalize customer hit list.
Manu: opened PR to rollback selector change: https://git.redwood/repo/rate-shaper/pulls/678 — includes corrected selector and unit tests. Will hold for post-incident review but ready to merge if needed.
Sasha: noticing retry amplification pattern from clients — we should add temporary de-dupe by id at edge to collapse identical retry loops. I'll prototype a quick rule to normalize id header and collapse duplicates for 1s window.
Priya: current status: mitigations applied, trending down. Monitor until stable for 30m. If error rate rises above 6% reopen pager. Handoff planned to Night Owls at 1753201600 if stable.
Oncall-Lead: @Priya confirm handoff checklist (runbook updated, slack thread link, follow-ups assigned).
Priya: checklist: mitigation toggled: DONE; bypass: DONE; support notified: DONE; rollback PR created: DONE; postmortem owner assigned (Emma): DONE. Handoff ETA 1753201600.
Emma: I'll take postmortem. Saving traces, logs, and timeline. Root cause hypothesis: mis-scoped rate-shaper selector + retry amplification. Long-term fixes: selector validation, deploy gating, token-bucket saturation alerts, and retry suppression at edge.
SupportLead: CS messages sent to affected customers; premium accounts offered credit. Tracking responses.
Priya: recommend severity = SEV-2 (regional partial outage for subset of tenants). Comments?
Sasha: agree SEV-2. Documenting escalation and exec summary for postmortem.
Manu: after PR merges we should run a canary and add a lint to warn on overly-broad selectors. Adding to infra backlog and assigning owners.
Emma: postmortem draft created and will include timeline, RCA, mitigations, and prevention items. I'll circulate tomorrow.
Carl: consolidated customer list posted to #support-customers and flagged account owners.
Priya: final notes: root cause = misapplied rate-shaper policy that imposed tight per-tenant buckets on high-throughput tenants -> generated 429s -> client retries amplified load -> gateway overloaded -> 502/504s. Mitigation = soft-fail toggle + tenant bypass + increased timeouts. Next steps = merge rollback PR, add selector validation, add retry suppression edge rules, update runbook, and follow-up postmortem.
PagerBot: incident marked mitigated at 1753201705. Monitoring continues; new pager will open if regressions occur. :white_check_mark:
Priya: handing off to Oncall-Lead. Leaving thread. Thanks everyone for the quick response.
